messages.subject: new logo release?
parts:
Michael --- do you want to go ahead and update the
web page with the new logo or should we wait for the
next official release, where we can include it with the
blog post, put it on the web, and add it to the manual
title page?

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] new logo release?

I'll work on seeing if I can get a slightly lower contrast
home page design with compatible colors.

The logo itself looks great!

I could live with a splash page in that dark red with
some bold white on it.

I keep meaning to get Jekyll going, but never seem to find
the time.
